purpose: Bounded qualification of the next free/public exact-identity source candidate for a current MULTIASSET_V2A SOURCE_RECOVERY_CANDIDATE gap after batch 1 adjudication.
qualification_requirements: Source must be official, free/public, auditable and legally accessible without private credentials.
Exact asset identity must match the frozen V2A coin_id/symbol; ticker equality alone is insufficient.
Pair existence and requested historical window must be proven from source bytes; preregistration does not assert V2A sufficiency.
Raw response/archive bytes or immutable objects must be preserved and SHA-256 hashed before normalization.
Manifest must record provider, endpoint/archive object, pair, request parameters, retrieval timestamp, raw hash and parser version.
Schema mapping and timestamp semantics/timezone must be explicit and deterministic.
Duplicate, missing-row, monotonic-time, OHLC and nonnegative-volume QA must pass fail-closed.
Coverage must satisfy the already-frozen V2A requirement; no threshold, cutoff, denominator or history-length rule may change.
No historical reconstruction from another token, renamed asset, derivative, wrapped representation or synthetic cross-rate is allowed.
Qualification data cannot count as prospective evidence and cannot repair prior point-in-time universe snapshots.
Any failed candidate remains a documented DATA_GAP; subsequent candidates require a new explicit qualification record or versioned extension.
